descFull: Vocello: a private voice studio for Apple Silicon. Write a script, pick or describe a voice, and generate speech locally on your Mac and iPhone. Native Swift and MLX, no Python, no cloud. Mac app and command line out now, iPhone beta on TestFlight. (Formerly QwenVoice.)
